articles.title: India's October Gross GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore
articles.summary: India's gross GST collection reached Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October, representing a 22.9% increase from last year. The gross GST collected for the April-October period totaled Rs 14.78 lakh crore, showing a 13.2% growth year-on-year. Maharashtra recorded the highest revenue for October at Rs 35,150 crore, followed by Karnataka and Gujarat. Some states, including Sikkim and Ladakh, experienced significant declines in GST collections during the month.

articles.title: 'Rs 10,000 crore businesses worth at risk': Delhi traders urge Sonia Gandhi to postpone November 1 Ramlila Maidan rally
articles.summary: The Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) has urged Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi to defer the INDIA bloc's November 1 mega-rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan until after Diwali. articles.title: India's services economy stays resilient as 17 sectors post growth
articles.summary: India's services sector recorded widespread growth in August, with 17 of the 19 tracked segments expanding and 13 registering double-digit gains, according to the trial Index of Service Production (ISP). Retail trade led the expansion with 19.9% year-on-year growth, followed by repair services and real estate at 17.6% each. Banking, insurance and IT services also reported strong growth, while CareEdge Ratings estimated overall services output rose 14%.
